ModMetaData.name: Trade Performance Fix
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
Removes a long freeze when a trade is set up in a colony with many items: opening the trade window, and every trade made by Auto Seller.
Cause: when RimWorld builds the list of tradeable items, it compares every item with every entry already in the list, and for each comparison it first checks whether the trader deals in that entry's item (a loop over all of the trader's stock rules). With a few thousand items this is hundreds of thousands of checks, which took about 5 seconds per trade in my colony.
Fix: while the list is being built, entries are indexed by item type. Two items can only be merged if they are the same type, so only entries of the same type are compared, in the original order. The resulting list is exactly the same.
Auto Seller (optional): after executing its trade, Auto Seller rebuilds the whole trade list as if the trade window were still open, which costs a second full build. Nothing uses that list afterwards, so it is now just emptied. In my colony (about 3,000 item stacks) an Auto Seller trade went from 11 seconds to 0.3 seconds.
Notes: - Safe to add to or remove from an existing save. - Works with or without Auto Seller.
